verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so headless or CI-driven automation (an API, CLI or programmatic runner) is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only in-product automation: reporting on 'autopilot', agents monitoring source data 24/7, and Slack tagging. Nothing documents a headless mode, CLI, CI integration or public API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
